notes.title: Soundtrack Now Available + Patch v1.1 Suggestions
notes.content:
Due to requests, Claire's soundtrack is now available, and is currently 33% off.

You can find it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/326270

Secondly, as we prepare Claire for ports, we're also upgrading the PC version. We'll be making some upgrades to the map system, adding dialogue, a new NewGame+ ending and a few other features. If there's something you'd really like to see improved or have any suggestions please mention it here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/252830/discussions/0/619568074742119270/

notes.title: Version 1.03.1 Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone, version 1.03.1 is now available. It fixes a variety of bugs and is our most stable build yet.

- Fixed controller input and rebinding issues.
- Fixed achievement bugs.
- Tweaked balance of panic in later parts of the game.
- Fixed bugs specific to Nightmare mode and NewGame+.
- Unlocked the NewGame+ only ending.
- Increased optimization for older video cards.
- Increased performance across the board.
- Fixed some scorecard issues such as damage taken and items used.
